theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) - Custom Variant: Esoteric Biotech / Sovereign Alchemical
theme_and_archetype.core_aesthetic: Gold-Glow Battery on Obsidian Black. Sacred geometry hints, gold filigree, occult-meets-medical, monospace data readouts. The UI feels like a sovereign relic.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-light tracking-tighter text-[#D4AF37] uppercase

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Mobile-First Dense Dashboard (Samsung S21 focus ~360x800). Use 'p-4' to 'p-6' internal padding on containers. Stack sections vertically.

surface_styles.relic_card: bg-[#111111] backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#D4AF37]/20 rounded-sm shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Subtle border glow increase: hover:border-[#D4AF37]/60 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)] transition-all duration-300

animations.battery_pulse: Slow ease-in-out breathing effect on the battery glow when optimal. Rapid sharp pulsing when critical (red).
animations.waveform_active: Staggered height changes for acoustic scanner to simulate live frequency monitoring.
animations.fade_in: Framer motion staggered fade-in for data elements.

health_battery_ui.description: Central vertical cylinder. Relic-like container with gold borders. Inner fill element expands vertically. Background color and box-shadow shift from #D4AF37 (Gold) to #FF3B30 (Red) based on the 0-100% score.
health_battery_ui.styles: h-64 w-16 border border-[#D4AF37]/40 relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-end
health_battery_ui.fill_styles: w-full transition-all duration-1000 ease-in-out bg-gradient-to-t from-[#AA8C2C] to-[#FFDF00] shadow-[0_0_20px_#D4AF37]

stomach_acoustic_scanner.description: A visualization of audio waveforms. Use a row of vertical thin divs with dynamically animating heights.
stomach_acoustic_scanner.interaction: Displays text result (Lectin Inflammation / MMC Stagnation / Optimal) using JetBrains Mono font.

fingerprint_abo_logic.description: Icon-driven upload area (use Lucide 'Fingerprint' icon). Gold text readout. Emphasize looping sacred geometric circles behind the fingerprint icon.
fingerprint_abo_logic.layout: Flex column, center aligned, bordered box with a subtle gold glow.

emergency_triage.description: Bento style mini-grid containing 'Vascular Asymmetry' and other metrics. Heavily monospaced, stark high-contrast look.
emergency_triage.layout: Grid cols-2 gap-2 p-4 bg-black border border-[#D4AF37]/20

emf_stealth_mode.description: Small header or footer widget showing RSSI (signal bars) and a text indicator 'SHIELD: ACTIVE'.
emf_stealth_mode.styles: flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-[#A1A1AA] mt-4

images.description: Dark obsidian gold texture used for subtle background grain or container overlay.
images.usage: Use with mix-blend-overlay and opacity-10 on the main body or specific relic cards to break flatness.

implementation_instructions_to_main_agen: Strictly follow the mobile-first focus. Target viewport is ~360x800.
Do NOT use 'Inter' or 'Space Grotesk'. Import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'JetBrains Mono' via Google Fonts.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Build the Health Battery entirely with Tailwind CSS (divs) to allow custom fluid animations of the height and drop-shadows. No third-party charting tools for the battery.
The UI should feel like a medical/esoteric instrument, NOT a standard SaaS dashboard. Rely heavily on 1px borders, uppercase monospace labels, and high-contrast text.
If wrapping in Framer Motion, make sure grid items are correct direct children.
